content.json:
# Compliance and review
**Synthetic data - not a legal passport.** Compliance lead / CSO / legal. This workbook observes decisions; it cannot clear a hold or approve a passport. SQL remains the record of truth. No allegation, evidence text, reviewer identity or prompt is displayed.

**No rows is unknown, not compliant.** Current holds need periodic `hold.snapshot` events, including closed states. A stale snapshot requires checking the app; historical `hold.resolved` events cannot establish current eligibility. A passed ledger check establishes that recorded verification only, not supplier truth or legal compliance. Persona workbooks are not access-control boundaries.

content.title: Latest hold states - reason, owner role and age (15-minute freshness limit)
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "hold.snapshot"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend series = tostring(customDimensions.series_id), hold = tostring(customDimensions.hold_id)
| where isnotempty(series) and isnotempty(hold)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by series, hold
| project series, hold, observed_at = timestamp, freshness = iff(timestamp < ago(15m), "STALE - check app", "Recent snapshot"), state = tostring(customDimensions.state), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code), owner_role = tostring(customDimensions.actor_role), age_minutes = todouble(customMeasurements.age_minutes)
| order by age_minutes desc

content.title: AI proposal versus applied disposition; resolutions and gate failures
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name in ("decision.recorded", "hold.resolved", "gate.failed")
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| project timestamp, event_type = name, series = tostring(customDimensions.series_id), battery = tostring(customDimensions.battery_id), proposal_action = tostring(customDimensions.proposal_action), applied_action = tostring(customDimensions.applied_action), actor_role = tostring(customDimensions.actor_role), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code), trace_id = operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 200

content.title: Compliance cases opened, decided by outcome and reopened
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name in ("compliance.case.opened", "compliance.case.decided", "compliance.case.reopened")
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| summarize observed_events = count() by event_type = name, series = tostring(customDimensions.series_id), decision = tostring(customDimensions.decision), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code)
| order by series asc, event_type asc

content.title: Open compliance cases and the oldest open case age (15-minute freshness limit)
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "passport.series.snapshot"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend series = tostring(customDimensions.series_id)
| where isnotempty(series)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by series
| project series, observed_at = timestamp, freshness = iff(timestamp < ago(15m), "STALE - check app", "Recent snapshot"), cases_open = tolong(customMeasurements.cases_open), oldest_case_minutes = todouble(customMeasurements.oldest_case_minutes)
| order by oldest_case_minutes desc

content.title: Denied compliance decision attempts - route and role, no identity
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "access.denied"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| where tostring(customDimensions.route_template) in ("/compliance/cases/{case_id}/decisions", "/cases/{case_id}/decide")
| summarize denied_attempts = count() by route = tostring(customDimensions.route_template), role = tostring(customDimensions.actor_role), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code)

content.title: Observed ledger verifications - absence is not a pass
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "ledger.verified"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by event
| project timestamp, result = tostring(customDimensions.result), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code), command_id = tostring(customDimensions.command_id), trace_id = operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 100

content.title: Latest Regulatory Watch recommendation states - review only, no policy activation
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "watch.recommendation"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend recommendation = tostring(customDimensions.recommendation_id)
| where isnotempty(recommendation)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by recommendation
| project timestamp, recommendation, state = tostring(customDimensions.state), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code), trace_id = operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
